services.name: airboat rides
services.desc: Enjoy the sights and surroundings of the beautiful Waccamaw, Black and Great Pee Dee Rivers aboard the Waccamaw Lady Sightseeing Tour or the Waccamaw Cooter/Gator Bait Airboat Tour, which depart from Wacca Wache Marina. On this 2 to 2-1/2 hour river cruise along the historic Waccamaw River, riders will enjoy a narration on six rice plantations nearby, as well as explore the natural beauty of the area. A local historian will narrate the history, mystery and legends of the rice plantations located along the Waccamaw River. Yes, there is a $3 off coupon in the Monster Coupon Book. services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Wacca Wache Marina offers reliable and secure boat storage in Murrells Inlet, SC. We are the top choice for boat owners seeking comprehensive storage options in the heart of South Carolina’s Lowcountry. We offer a range of storage solutions, including wet slips for easy access to the water and secure dry stack boat storage to keep your vessel protected when not in use for longer periods of time. Our boat storage facilities can accommodate boats of various sizes, ensuring safe and flexible storage for long-term and short-term stays.
